text: Play Snake on a 10 by 10 board. The blue head has a white arrow showing its direction; connected green segments form the body, fading lighter from neck to the pointed tail; only consecutive body segments are connected. The red circle is food. Each action moves one cell. Left and right turn relative to the current heading; straight keeps the heading. Eating food grows the snake. Hitting a wall or the body ends the game; the tail vacates its cell on a non-eating move. Maximize food and survival. Use the CURRENT screenshot to adapt any earlier plan.
